# Remote Work Policy

Revision: v04. Effective: 2024-05-13. Owner: Chief Compliance Officer.

## 1. Purpose

This document sets the minimum requirements for remote work. It exists so that every team applies the same
rules the same way, and so that an auditor can check that they do.

## 2. Scope

This document applies to the systems and suppliers listed in the asset register. Where a contract or a law imposes a stricter
requirement, the stricter requirement applies.

## 3. Definitions

- In-scope systems: every system listed in the asset register with this policy as its control set.
- Owner: the role accountable for this document and for approving exceptions to it.
- Confirmed event: an event that the response team has classified, as opposed to a report.
- Working day: Monday to Friday excluding public holidays at the registered office.

## 4. Requirements

- **R1.** Backups of in-scope systems run at least every 24 hours and are tested quarterly.
- **R2.** Test and development environments never hold production data unless it has been anonymised.
- **R3.** Staff complete the related training within thirty days of joining and annually thereafter.
- **R4.** Devices that store in-scope data are encrypted at rest with a managed key.
- **R5.** Interactive sessions expire after 4 hours and require re-authentication.
- **R6.** Passwords are at least 12 characters long and are checked against a list of known compromised passwords.
- **R7.** Monitoring alerts are triaged within one business hour during working hours.
- **R8.** Records covered by this policy are retained for 60 days from the date of their creation and then deleted.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions are granted only where a requirement cannot be met for technical or legal reasons, are
time-limited, and are reviewed at every scheduled review of this document.

## 6. Review and ownership

The owner of this document is the Chief Compliance Officer, who approves exceptions and signs off every revision.
Material changes are communicated to all affected teams before they take effect.
